node.content-desc: Security & privacy notification: Set a screen lock

node.text: Choose a folder in Files, Drive, or removable storage. Automatic portable backups are plain JSON, not encrypted. Whip keeps access after restart, verifies every backup after writing it, and never deletes unrelated files.
Encrypted backups are authenticated and safer for health history and other sensitive data. The passphrase is never saved and cannot be recovered. Plain JSON remains available for interoperability.
Reset clears Whip's internal data and settings, disconnects the portable backup folder, and returns to setup. External backup files remain available.
